verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API docs confirm that accounts can have multiple locations beyond the default one, that location information is managed via the API and the Square Dashboard, and that some settings are per-location, such as custom receipt text. Nothing in the pack shows devices being assigned to locations or reporting broken out by location. missing for 10: per-location device assignment/management, per-location reporting/analytics, broader per-location settings beyond receipts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
